clues: This city sits at the far tip of the Olympic Peninsula. It is in Washington state, in the far west of the US.
This place stays much drier than the land around it. High mountains block wet air and steal its rain first.
This town had its best years in the late 1800s. Many grand old buildings from that time still stand here today.
Small shops here still build boats by hand near the sea. This old craft is a big part of town life today.
Its old center is a landmark district kept with care. Few towns in the land hold such a prized old heart.
